Publish.LongDescription:
Discord RPC gives Cities: Skylines II a richer, configurable Discord presence without opening a second Discord connection.
FEATURES
• Live city activity, population, date, season, weather, temperature and optional traffic flow. • Private-by-default city names and configurable population/treasury precision. • Custom Details and State templates with readable tokens. • Session timer and activity preview. • Connection diagnostics, manual refresh and automatic reconnect attempts. • Optional companion activity for Access Studio, Road Rules, Event Engine and Traffic Stress Lab. • One-click disable restores the vanilla Cities: Skylines II rich-presence updater.
SAFE ARCHITECTURE
Discord RPC reuses the official Discord Game SDK client already created by Cities: Skylines II (client ID 1125009418476605441). It does not ship another SDK, request a token, launch a helper process or create competing Discord ownership.
PRIVACY
City name sharing, treasury and companion activity are OFF by default. Population is rounded by default. Companion activity may include text provided by another mod; enable it only for mods you trust. Discord RPC itself never reads save paths, account names or mod lists for presence.
BETA NOTE
This package remains an unlisted beta until a real Discord desktop client accepts and visibly displays its activity during the release-gate test.
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.9.1-beta.1
• Refined panel layout, connection feedback and privacy preset selection. • Connection failure panel opens once per failure instead of reopening after dismissal. • Companion activity is opt-in on new installs and respects the setting for all activity providers. • Updated Traffic Stress Lab activity wording for road departures.
0.9.0-beta.1
• Shared-client Discord Game SDK architecture. • Custom presence templates and live preview. • Private, Social and Detailed privacy presets. • Population, money, date, season, weather and traffic tokens. • Reconnect state and callback diagnostics. • Companion mod activity priority with automatic expiry. • Cooperative vanilla updater restoration.
Unlisted beta: public release requires visible Discord-client runtime proof.
